snippet.title: Robot Recycler Ryn - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Robot Recycler Ryn now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585390/Robot_Recycler_Ryn/

Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn’s story, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

Features
- Advanced construction gameplay: craft robotic limbs piece by piece using a variety of tools
- Your robots’ power depends on how well you did in the construction phases
- Assemble mechanical limbs to create combat robots
- Choose between active battles or auto-battles
- Two game modes: Follow Ryn in Story Mode or build robots freely in the Construction Mode
- Discover a captivating post-apocalyptic world

Follow us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Rablo_Games
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/jzR7YXv6Z3
Follow us on X/Twitter: https://x.com/RabloGames
